title: Walk in the Light
summaryZh: 耶穌是世界的光，當我們降服並跟從祂，就能走出黑暗，得著全新的生命。
lines: You ever felt lost in life?
你曾對人生感到迷惘嗎？
Kind of like trying to navigate a dark room, walking around aimlessly, unsure of your next step.
就像試著在暗房裡摸索，漫無目的地走著，不知道下一步該往哪裡走。
It's unsettling, disorienting, and even stressful.
這令人不安、失去方向，甚至感到備受壓力。
After their escape from Egypt, the people of Israel were lost and wandered in the wilderness for forty years.
以色列人逃離埃及後，迷失了方向，在曠野飄流了四十年。
But God sent a pillar of cloud that would guide them by day and it would turn to fire to guide them by night.
但神差遣雲柱在白晝引導他們，到了夜間則變成火柱來引導他們。
God’s faithfulness to guide them is celebrated in the Feast of Tabernacles.
住棚節就是在慶祝神引導他們的信實。
And a major component of the Feast of Tabernacles was the lighting of big lamps in the temple courts.
而住棚節的一個主要環節，就是在聖殿的院子裡點燃大燈。
The lights were a reminder of God guiding them by night.
這些燈光提醒著他們神在夜間的引導。
And it is within that context, during the Feast of Tabernacles, that Jesus made this powerful statement:
正是在那樣的背景下，在住棚節期間，耶穌作出了這個強而有力的宣告：
“I am the light of the world.
Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness but will have the light of life.”
跟從我的，就不在黑暗裡走，必要得著生命的光。」
Jesus was saying, “I know God sent your ancestors a light to guide them before but now he’s sent the light of the world to lead you into salvation now.”
耶穌的意思是：「我知道神過去曾賜給你們祖先光來引導他們，但現在祂差遣了世界的光，要在此刻引領你們進入救恩。」
When we surrender to and follow Jesus, we’ll never walk in the disorienting darkness because Jesus illuminates for us a new life.
當我們降服並跟從耶穌時，我們就再也不會走在令人迷失的黑暗中，因為耶穌為我們照亮了新生命。
Jesus, the light of the world, came to be the light of your world.
耶穌，這世界的光，來作你生命世界的光。
So be encouraged today that the light of Jesus dispels the darkness of fear, shame, brokenness, sin, and death with the light of peace, purpose, forgiveness, restoration, hope, and grace.
所以今天願你得著鼓勵，耶穌的光用平安、目標、饒恕、恢復、盼望和恩典的光，驅散了恐懼、羞恥、破碎、罪惡與死亡的黑暗。
